messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick pulse — need to lock webinar topic & run-of-show this week. I'm leaning to 'Real-world inference: cost & latency tradeoffs' but we need a sharper hook for PLG/product teams. Thoughts?

aj singh: Love it. Two useful abstract routes: (1) benchmarks deep-dive, (2) pragmatic migration guide. We should draft both and pick based on early RSVP signals. Who wants which?

leo park: I can take the benchmark abstract. @nina — would you like the migration guide? Proposed speaker slate: Sarah (runtime), Tom (platform), Derek (customer).

nina kozlov: Yep I'll co-author the migration piece. Recommend 30m content + 10m Q, but could be 45m if we want a proper demo. Also propose we surface a customer snippet to prove unit economics.

maria gonzalez: Good call. Action: 3x one-paragraph abstracts by Tue, 50-word speaker bios, and 2 short demo scripts (primary + fallback). Ops: check rehearsal slots. :calendar:

ops-bot: Booked rehearsal: 2026-04-06 10:00 PDT — calendar invites sent to listed speakers.

aj singh: For invite copy, let's A/B test two opening lines: A) 'How we cut per-token cost 3x without accuracy loss' vs B) 'Scale LLMs without trading off latency' — A is more clicky, B is more trust. We can run a small community pretest.

leo park: A gets opens, B converts to signups maybe. Let's poll the community channel (20 ppl sample) before we finalize. @maria can you spin up the poll?

maria gonzalez: Poll live: https://slack-redwood/community/polls/3421. Also note Lina from Growth wants enterprise leads routed to AE queue with 24h demo follow-up SLO. @aj please confirm routing.

aj singh: Routing set: enterprise -> /ae-queue, add tag 'webinar:infer-econ' in HubSpot. Demo follow-up SLO documented.

nina kozlov: Drafts are on Miro: https://miro.com/app/board/uX_example. Quick read: benchmark draft is too deep on microbench numbers — shorten and lead with outcomes (latency, cost, dev effort).

leo park: Updated benchmark v2 on Miro and sketched run-of-show. Proposed:
```
0:00-0:05 Intro & framing (maria)
0:05-0:20 Benchmark findings (leo)
0:20-0:30 Live demo (tom)
0:30-0:37 Customer story (derek)
0:37-0:45 Live Q + CTAs
```
Can we trim to keep energy high?

maria gonzalez: Trim demo to 8m, customer to 7m, free 5m for live questions. Must have a backup if demo flakes: prerec clip + fallback slides. @leo please prepare the 90s prerec clip.

aj singh: Infra will run a rehearsal healthcheck 48h before show: model pinned, token caps, autoscaling smoke test. Checklist: capacity, model checkpoint, kv-cache warmup, prompt rate limits. I'll own it.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal 48h before event; automated healthchecks at 24h and 2h pre-show.

maria gonzalez: Next steps — leo: speaker bios + prerec clip by Fri; aj: lead routing & infra healthcheck by Thu; nina: final abstracts + one slide per section by Fri. Mini-rehearsal Wed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
